project_type: Monorepo with LINE webhook Lambda (TypeScript) + AgentCore agents (Python) + CDK infra (TypeScript)
test_framework: vitest for TypeScript functions, pytest with pytest-asyncio for Python agent
test_command: pnpm test (runs vitest in functions package), cd packages/agent && uv run pytest (for Python)
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install, 2. pnpm typecheck (runs tsc --noEmit for functions and infra), 3. Python: cd packages/agent && uv run pytest
setup_instructions: pnpm install for Node, cd packages/agent && uv sync for Python
environment_constraints: Network mode not confirmed, but changes are code-only. No new dependencies needed.
contribution_requirements: CI checks TypeScript type-check (pnpm typecheck). No Python CI configured.
key_patterns: handler.ts dispatches LINE commands via invokeAgent() to AgentCore. main.py routes actions to handler functions. print_generator/entrypoint.py's handle_generate_print() reads params dict from payload. adaptive_learning/agent.py has determine_next_problem(child_id, current_unit_order) returning {category, subcategory, difficulty, question_count, weak_areas, should_advance}. Children table has current_unit_order field. CHILDREN_TABLE env var is available in agent code.
directory_structure: packages/functions/src/webhook/ - LINE webhook handler, packages/functions/src/shared/ - shared utilities (family, state, agentcore, s3), packages/agent/src/ - AgentCore agents (print_generator, grading, adaptive_learning), packages/agent/tests/ - pytest tests, packages/infra/ - CDK infra
